run_convert_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint
convert_finetune_checkpoint: convert a fine-tuned checkpoint by copying backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
convert_finetune_checkpoint_with_yaml: convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and its YAML config to release format
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges backbone and heads config
refactor_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: refactor convert_fine_tune_checkpoint to support additional checkpoint fields beyond backbone and heads
